task.title: Work across editor tabs
task.shortdesc: Use separate browser tabs for saved-profile modes without confusing drafts or losing unsaved changes.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: BPM opens saved profile modes and comparison surfaces in separate tabs so users can inspect Guided, All settings, JSON, and Compare side by side.

step.cmd: Open a saved profile from the Library in the required editor mode.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Keep the profile name, schema channel, and lifecycle badge visible in each tab.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Save changes in one tab before relying on another tab for export, comparison, or validation.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Close or refresh tabs only after checking the unsaved-change warning and visible save status.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: You can review multiple surfaces while keeping the authoritative saved state clear.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
